note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The route (points, review desk, configured return point) is SUPPLIED: only the filter doors of routes.returnTo stand open, and the folder goes back there because the author configured it — no rule about where a case must be returned is drawn or implied. The review notes are supplied placeholder texts. The renewed examination is never shown and has no outcome; the calendar marks no date and implies no time limit. Brief fields: decisions, grounds (the notes), routes, outcomes, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState (its caption is outcomes.returned) are editable.
